title: review: R17 v3: orchestrator/roadmap.py + roadmap-status — machine-readable completion report mapping every Phase I P0-P7 and Adaptive Parallelism P0-P18 requirement to status, files, tests, config, telemetry and activation state
spec:
Why: brief P16 requires .orchestrator/roadmap-status.json after implementation, with statuses implemented_active | implemented_shadow | implemented_off | partial | missing | not_applicable, and the goal is incomplete while any non-experimental requirement is partial or missing.
What: orchestrator/roadmap.py with REQUIREMENTS: a literal list of dicts {id, program ('phase-i'|'adaptive-parallelism'), priority, title, experimental: bool, files: [...], tests: ['tests/test_x.py::test_name', ...], config: [table.key ...], telemetry: [runs paths / keys], mode_key: optional 'table.key'} covering every requirement in .orchestrator/phase-i-program.md P0-P7 and .orchestrator/adaptive-parallelism-program.md P0-P18 plus brief P14/P15 (decision log, promotion); status(req, root, cfg) derives: missing when any listed file is absent; partial when a listed test id is not defined (reuse acceptance.named_tests/missing_tests logic on the repo root); otherwise implemented_active when mode_key is active or absent, implemented_shadow when the configured mode is shadow, implemented_off when off; not_applicable only where the list says so with a reason. build(root, cfg) -> {generated_at, base_sha, requirements: [...], summary: counts, complete: no non-experimental requirement partial/missing}; write(path) -> .orchestrator/roadmap-status.json; cli `orchestrator roadmap-status [--json] [--write]`. Tests: this repo runs unittest; every acceptance test id is a `def test_name(self)` method inside a unittest.TestCase subclass in the named file; no pytest fixtures; use the daemon test harness in tests/_harness.py.
acceptance: tests/test_roadmap.py::test_every_brief_priority_is_covered — REQUIREMENTS contains at least one entry for each of Phase I P0-P7 and AP P0-P18 and the brief's P14/P15

tests/test_roadmap.py::test_status_derivation_missing_partial_and_modes — a missing file yields missing, an undefined test yields partial, a shadow-mode key yields implemented_shadow, off yields implemented_off, no mode key yields implemented_active
tests/test_roadmap.py::test_build_on_repo_marks_goal_complete — build() over the real repo reports complete True with zero non-experimental partial or missing requirements
tests/test_cli.py::test_cli_roadmap_status_writes_json — roadmap-status --write creates .orchestrator/roadmap-status.json with the summary counts

result.summary: Verified orchestrator/roadmap.py, cli.py wiring, and both test files. Ran the actual test suite (test_roadmap.py, test_cli.py) in the T-0669 worktree: all 28 tests pass, including test_build_on_repo_marks_goal_complete against the real repo. REQUIREMENTS entries (titles, P-numbers, experimental flags) were cross-checked against .orchestrator/phase-i-program.md and adaptive-parallelism-program.md headings and match exactly, including P7/P17 experimental flags. status()/build()/write() logic matches the spec's derivation order (not_applicable -> missing -> partial via acceptance.missing_tests(runner='unittest') -> mode_key shadow/off/active), and acceptance.missing_tests/named_tests are called with correct signatures. No command injection or unsafe eval in the subprocess.run/tomllib usage. No correctness bugs found against the four acceptance criteria.
